# grove prune: merged PR lookup uses fake GitHub CLI data offline

setup_workspace feature-pr-merged

# Give the branch a commit not in main, then make its upstream disappear.
exec git -C $WORK/testrepo checkout feature-pr-merged
cp $WORK/merged.txt $WORK/testrepo/merged.txt
exec git -C $WORK/testrepo add .
exec git -C $WORK/testrepo commit -m 'PR commit'
exec git -C $WORK/testrepo checkout main
exec git -C $WORK/workspace/.bare fetch origin
exec grove add feature-pr-merged
exec git -C $WORK/testrepo branch -D feature-pr-merged

env FAKE_GH_LOG=$WORK/gh.log
env FAKE_GH_PR_LIST=$WORK/merged-prs.json
exec grove prune --commit
assert_branch deleted feature-pr-merged

# A failed optional lookup is reported in debug output and does not stop prune.
exec git -C $WORK/testrepo checkout -b feature-pr-failure
cp $WORK/failure.txt $WORK/testrepo/failure.txt
exec git -C $WORK/testrepo add .
exec git -C $WORK/testrepo commit -m 'failed lookup commit'
exec git -C $WORK/testrepo checkout main
exec git -C $WORK/workspace/.bare fetch origin
exec grove add feature-pr-failure
exec git -C $WORK/testrepo branch -D feature-pr-failure
env FAKE_GH_FAIL='pr list'
env FAKE_GH_EXIT=27
env FAKE_GH_STDERR='fake list failure'
exec grove --debug prune --commit
stderr 'GitHub PR check unavailable: gh pr list failed: fake list failure'
exec git -C $WORK/workspace/.bare rev-parse --verify feature-pr-failure

cmpenv $WORK/gh.log $WORK/want-gh.log

-- merged.txt --
merged by PR

-- failure.txt --
not merged

-- merged-prs.json --
[{"headRefName":"feature-pr-merged"}]

-- want-gh.log --
["auth","status"]
["pr","list","--state","merged","--json","headRefName","--limit","200"]
["auth","status"]
["pr","list","--state","merged","--json","headRefName","--limit","200"]
